english: 36-40. It is the power of ignorance that makes man subject to misery. If that ignorance disappears, he obtains excellent happiness. The termination of ignorance is possible only through knowledge and not through action. Knowledge is indeed the knowledge of Supreme Brahman, which arises from the Vedāntic statements. That knowledge comes only to the one who is unattached and not to anyone else. It is the truth that the one (the disciple) acquires through the favour of the Ācārya (Preceptor) who is the most important authority. When all the desires that are lurking in his heart become eliminated, the man becomes immortal. He attains Brahman here itself. Whether this man is awake or asleep, taking food or standing by, the cruel god of Death always (at any time) drags him.
